content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-what-nobody-tells-2|selling]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where everything breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how|Cloudflare Workers]] Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Usdt payment

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The USDT payment gateway architecture consists of a combination of tools and services, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments. GitHub Pages hosts the digital product store, while Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, order storage, and file delivery. Supabase and Google Drive ensure seamless integration with Google Drive for file delivery. NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments, converting them to USD in real-time. This architecture enables creators to maintain complete control over their commerce infrastructure and reduces dependence on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products in countries or regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are restricted or unavailable. These creators often face significant platform fees, ranging from 10% to 20% per sale. By using USDT payment gateways, they can bypass these fees, increase revenue, and maintain sovereignty over their commerce operations. This solution is particularly suited for creators in Zimbabwe and other countries with restrictive payment infrastructure.
NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The USDT payment gateway solution consists of several key components, including GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, Google Drive for file delivery, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. These components work together seamlessly to provide a fully functional digital commerce stack that enables creators to accept cryptocurrency payments, store orders, and deliver digital products to customers. With NOWPayments, creators can access a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and convert them to USD in real-time, ensuring seamless payment processing and reduced transaction fees.
